description: Project scaffold, Bun-native config, single-port server wiring, and Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui (new-york) setup. This is the foundation every later FEAT depends on. Create package.json (Bun scripts, React 19, Elysia, no Node tooling), bunfig.toml (bun-plugin-tailwind), tsconfig.json (@/* alias), components.json (new-york/neutral/cssVariables/lucide, pre-created BEFORE shadcn so init stays non-interactive), .gitignore (node_modules, store.sqlite), src/server.ts wiring ONE Bun.serve() that serves the bundled HTML frontend via a route AND mounts the Elysia app as the /api handler, a minimal src/frontend (index.html + main.tsx + globals.css + App.tsx + lib/utils.ts) that renders a 'BooksOnline' shell with the specified logo so the stack is provably bootable, and the shadcn ui primitives. Independent of FEAT-002..006 except that it must exist first.

findings: SCAFFOLD COMPLETE & VERIFIED. Environment: Bun 1.4.2, bunx 1.4.2 on Windows/PowerShell. Git repo initialized at workspace root on branch 'main' (none existed before). RESOLVED VERSIONS (pinned in package.json + bun.lock): elysia@1.4.30, react@19.3.0, react-dom@19.3.0, lucide-react@1.54.0, class-variance-authority@0.7.1, clsx@2.1.1, tailwind-merge@3.7.0; devDeps typescript@7.0.2 (the native/tsgo compiler), @types/react@19.3.0, @types/react-dom@19.3.0, bun-types@1.4.2, tailwindcss@4 (4.3.3), bun-plugin-tailwind@0.1.2. shadcn also pulled in sonner@2.0.8, radix-ui@1.7.0 (shadcn new-york uses the unified 'radix-ui' package, importing e.g. `import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "radix-ui"` -- NOT the old @radix-ui/react-* packages), and next-themes@0.4.6 (used by components/ui/sonner.tsx via useTheme). No vite/webpack/esbuild anywhere. ALIAS: '@/*' -> './src/frontend/*' (so '@/lib/utils' = src/frontend/lib/utils.ts, '@/components/ui/*' = src/frontend/components/ui/*). PORT: 3000 default, override via env PORT. DEV: NODE_ENV!=='production' toggles Bun.serve development mode. SERVER WIRING: ONE Bun.serve() in src/server.ts using routes map ONLY -> '/api/*': (req)=>api.fetch(req) (matched before the SPA catch-all) and '/*': index (the imported HTMLBundle). NOTE: a `fetch` fallback does NOT work here because Bun matches `routes` before `fetch`, so '/api/*' MUST be an explicit route delegating to Elysia (a '/*' catch-all would otherwise swallow /api and serve HTML). Elysia app in src/api/index.ts is `new Elysia({ prefix: '/api' }).get('/health', ...)`; later FEATs .use() domain modules onto it. UNKNOWN /api/* paths correctly 404 via Elysia. DEVIATIONS FROM TASK TEXT (all required by the pinned toolchain, no behavior change): (1) tsconfig OMITS 'baseUrl' -- TypeScript 7.0.2 removed the baseUrl option; the '@/*' paths mapping works without it (paths resolve relative to tsconfig dir). (2) Added src/env.d.ts with `declare module "*.css";` because bun-types declares *.html but NOT *.css, so the side-effect `import './globals.css'` in main.tsx needs an ambient module decl to type-check. (3) shadcn CLI wrote `import { cn } from "cn"` in all 12 ui components that use cn and installed a bogus `cn` npm package; FIXED by rewriting every import to `@/lib/utils` and running `bun remove cn`. Later FEATs adding shadcn components should expect the same CLI quirk and must rewrite `from "cn"` -> `from "@/lib/utils"`. shadcn primitives present in src/frontend/components/ui: button, card, dialog, input, label, checkbox, dropdown-menu, select, badge, separator, sonner, tabs, skeleton. VERIFICATION RESULTS: `bun install` ok (112 installs/143 pkgs); `bunx tsc --noEmit` -> 0 errors; background boot on :3000 -> GET / = HTTP 200 with bundled HTML (title 'BooksOnline', favicon = meetup2.svg logo, injected <link ... /_bun/asset/*.css> served 200 ~20KB Tailwind, injected <script ... /_bun/client/*.js>, <div id=root>), GET /api/health = {status:'ok'}, GET /api/does-not-exist = 404; server stopped after probe, no bun processes left running. store.sqlite is gitignored and not yet created (no DB code in this FEAT). WINDOWS GOTCHA observed: an orphaned background bun server from a prior/unrelated run can hold port 3000 and serve a STALE bundle -- always `Get-Process bun | Stop-Process` before probing, and bound the server (Start-Process -PassThru then Stop-Process -Id).
